permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Load customers, projects, storyboards, shots, script, schedule and packing list from the Shoot Day server you enter in the phone app, and save takes, done scenes and new customers there. A private build may also stream voice to your own speech server; no other server is contacted.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional voice commands: hold to speak on the packing list, pick Voice for a take, or say the name of a new customer. Audio is recorded only while you speak (at most 2 minutes) and goes only to your own Shoot Day server and, if built in, your own live speech recognition server.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Optional, for the Light view only: sun position, golden and blue hour where you are, computed on the phone. Asked only when you open Light; the place never leaves the phone.
